name: training-impact-pack
description: Claude Guide for Training Impact: 30 Claude skills for proving what a training programme changed, from the request to the decision about what comes next, in seven stages: question the request with a request brief, sponsor discovery questions and a performance problem diagnosis; agree what proof looks like with a critical behaviours map, a success measures agreement and a baseline plan; collect the evidence with two surveys, an observation checklist, an interview guide and a data request; read it honestly in a before-and-after results table and a contribution analysis; tell the sponsor with success cases, a return as a range and a one-pager; report to the business with a metrics set, a quarterly report and an overclaim check; then feed it back through a review meeting, a decision record and a business case. For L&D managers, L&D specialists and L&D leaders. Claude plans the evaluation and drafts the report from your data; it never invents a result, a benchmark or a quote, and a named person stands behind every number.
